<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix">
  <sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
    <sys_id>c6507267144d44369845b85186bb83ed</sys_id>
    <sys_scope display_value="x_snc_habitat">16ba15190f59831008dd5ee530d1b2b4</sys_scope>
    <sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_c6507267144d44369845b85186bb83ed</sys_update_name>
    <description>Corrige les enregistrements créés avant installation des sys_number (TASK → HAB pour demandes, TASK → DOS pour dossiers)</description>
    <name>Fix numéros TASK vers HAB et DOS</name>
    <script>
(function() {
    // Fix demandes mobilité
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_habitat_demande_mobilite');
    gr.addQuery('number', 'STARTSWITH', 'TASK');
    gr.query();
    var counter = 1006;
    while (gr.next()) {
        var pad = '0000000' + counter;
        gr.setValue('number', 'HAB' + pad.substring(pad.length - 7));
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        gr.update();
        gs.info('Fixed demande: ' + gr.number);
        counter++;
    }
    // Update sys_number counter
    var sn = new GlideRecord('sys_number');
    sn.addQuery('category', 'x_snc_habitat_demande_mobilite');
    sn.query();
    if (sn.next()) {
        sn.setValue('number', counter);
        sn.update();
    }

    // Fix dossiers métier
    var gd = new GlideRecord('x_snc_habitat_dossier_metier');
    gd.addQuery('number', 'STARTSWITH', 'TASK');
    gd.orderBy('sys_created_on');
    gd.query();
    var dcounter = 1021;
    while (gd.next()) {
        var dpad = '0000000' + dcounter;
        gd.setValue('number', 'DOS' + dpad.substring(dpad.length - 7));
        gd.setWorkflow(false);
        gd.update();
        gs.info('Fixed dossier: ' + gd.number);
        dcounter++;
    }
    // Update sys_number counter for dossiers
    var sd = new GlideRecord('sys_number');
    sd.addQuery('category', 'x_snc_habitat_dossier_metier');
    sd.query();
    if (sd.next()) {
        sd.setValue('number', dcounter);
        sd.update();
    }

    gs.info('Fix complete: ' + (counter - 1006) + ' demandes, ' + (dcounter - 1021) + ' dossiers fixed');
})();
</script>
  </sys_script_fix>
</record_update>
